arxiv-2108-04685.title: Influence of cutoff dipole interaction radius and dilution on phase transition in kagome artificial spin ice Journal: Journal Name
arxiv-2108-04685.creator: Petr Andriushchenko
arxiv-2108-04685.description: Abstract The investigations carried out in this paper show the influence of cutoff dipole interaction radius and dilution on the basic thermodynamic characteristics of the kagome artificial spin ice with free boundary conditions. The phase transition disappearance at the dipole interaction radius limitation was shown in our previous study by Shevchenko et al. [JETP 124 (6), 982–993 (2017)].

arxiv-2203-14723.title: R R -matrix analysis of 22 Ne( α \alpha , n) 25 Mg and 22 Ne( α \alpha , γ \gamma ) 26 Mg reaction
arxiv-2203-14723.creator: Rajkumar Santra
arxiv-2203-14723.description: Abstract The 22 Ne( α \alpha , n) 25 Mg and its competing channel 22 Ne( α \alpha , γ \gamma ) 26 Mg has an major influence on neutron flux in weak s-process nucleosynthesis path in low mass AGB stars and massive stars of mass (M ≥ \geq 10M ⊙ ).

arxiv-2205-13359.title: Feature Forgetting in Continual Representation Learning
arxiv-2205-13359.creator: Xiao Zhang, Dejing Dou, Ji Wu
arxiv-2205-13359.description: Abstract In continual and lifelong learning, good representation learning can help increase performance and reduce sample complexity when learning new tasks. There is evidence that representations do not suffer from “catastrophic forgetting” even in plain continual learning, but little further fact is known about its characteristics.

arxiv-2305-12160.title: Park visitation and walkshed demographics in the United States
arxiv-2305-12160.creator: Kelsey Linnell, Mikaela Fudolig, Laura Bloomfield, Thomas McAndrew, Taylor H. Ricketts, Jarlath P. M. O’Neil-Dunne, Peter Sheridan Dodds, Christopher M. Danforth
arxiv-2305-12160.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kelsey Linnell, Mikaela Fudolig, Laura Bloomfield, Thomas McAndrew, Taylor H. Ricketts, Jarlath P. M. O’Neil-Dunne, Peter Sheridan Dodds, Christopher M. Danforth. A large and growing body of research demonstrates the value of local parks to mental and physical well-being. Recently, researchers have begun using passive digital data sources to investigate equity in usage; exactly who is benefiting from parks?

arxiv-2306-06650.title: Scanning NV magnetometry of focused-electron-beam-deposited cobalt nanomagnets
arxiv-2306-06650.creator: Liza Žaper, Peter Rickhaus, Marcus Wyss, Boris Gross, Martino Poggio, Floris Braakman
arxiv-2306-06650.description: Abstract Focused-electron-beam-induced deposition is a promising technique for patterning nanomagnets for spin qubit control in a single step. We fabricate cobalt nanomagnets in such a process, obtaining cobalt contents and saturation magnetizations comparable to or higher than those typically obtained using electron-beam lithography.

arxiv-2407-03017.title: High-order Uncertain Differential Equation and Its Application to Nuclear Reactors
arxiv-2407-03017.creator: Hao Li, Yuqian Wang
arxiv-2407-03017.description: Abstract High-order uncertain differential equation (HUDE) was introduced in literature. But the present method to solve a HUDE is incorrect. In this paper, we will rigorously prove some comparion theorems of high-order differential equations, and present a method to solve a family of HUDE, including parameter estimation and hypothesis test.

arxiv-2410-13746.title: Theory on Score-Mismatched Diffusion Models and Zero-Shot Conditional Samplers
arxiv-2410-13746.creator: Yuchen Liang †, Peizhong Ju ‡, Yingbin Liang †, Ness Shroff †, ‡ University of Kentucky
arxiv-2410-13746.description: Abstract The denoising diffusion model has recently emerged as a powerful generative technique, capable of transforming noise into meaningful data. While theoretical convergence guarantees for diffusion models are well established when the target distribution aligns with the training distribution, practical scenarios often present mismatches.

arxiv-2412-13285.title: A Family of Instanton-Invariants for Four-Manifolds and Their Relation to Khovanov Homology
arxiv-2412-13285.creator: Michael BLEHER
arxiv-2412-13285.description: Abstract This article provides a review of the gauge-theoretic approach to Khovanov homology, framed in terms of a generalisation of Witten’s original proposal. Concretely, the physical arguments underlying Witten’s insights suggest that there is a one-parameter family of Haydys–Witten instanton Floer homology groups H ​ F θ ​ ( W 4 ) HF_{\theta}\bigl(W^{4}\bigr) for four-manifolds.

arxiv-2501-12456.title: Deploying Privacy Guardrails for LLMs: A Comparative Analysis of Real-World Applications
arxiv-2501-12456.creator: Shubhi Asthana, Bing Zhang, Ruchi Mahindru, Chad DeLuca
arxiv-2501-12456.description: Abstract The adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) has revolutionized AI applications but poses significant challenges in safeguarding user privacy. Ensuring compliance with privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA while addressing nuanced privacy risks requires robust and scalable frameworks.

arxiv-2503-12502.title: Enhanced Approximation Algorithms for the Capacitated Location Routing Problem
arxiv-2503-12502.creator: Jingyang Zhao, Mingyu Xiao, Shunwang Wang
arxiv-2503-12502.description: Abstract The Capacitated Location Routing Problem is an important planning and routing problem in logistics, which generalizes the capacitated vehicle routing problem and the uncapacitated facility location problem. In this problem, we are given a set of depots and a set of customers where each depot has an opening cost and each customer has a demand.

arxiv-2506-19054.title: GuardSet-X : Multi-Domain, Policy-Grounded, AI Security Guardrail Benchmark
arxiv-2506-19054.creator: Mintong Kang, Zhaorun Chen, Chejian Xu, Jiawei Zhang, Chengquan Guo, Minzhou Pan, Ivan Revilla, Yu Sun, Bo Li
arxiv-2506-19054.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mintong Kang, Zhaorun Chen, Chejian Xu, Jiawei Zhang, Chengquan Guo, Minzhou Pan, Ivan Revilla, Yu Sun, Bo Li. As large language models (LLMs) become widespread across diverse applications, concerns about the security and safety of LLM interactions have intensified. Numerous guardrail models and benchmarks have been developed to ensure LLM content safety. However, existing guardrail benchmarks are often built upon ad hoc risk taxonomies that lack a principled grounding in standardized safety policies , limiting their alignment with real-world operational requirements.

arxiv-2509-05250.title: A strong–weak duality for the 1d long-range Ising model
arxiv-2509-05250.creator: Dario Benedetti, Edoardo Lauria, Dalimil Mazáč, Philine van Vliet
arxiv-2509-05250.description: Abstract We investigate the one-dimensional Ising model with long-range interactions decaying as 1 / r 1 + s 1/r^{1+s} . In the critical regime, for 1 / 2 ≤ s ≤ 1 1/2\leq s\leq 1 , this system realizes a family of nontrivial one-dimensional conformal field theories (CFTs), whose data vary continuously with s s .

arxiv-2509-07366.title: Alter-magnetic properties in the perovskite compounds
arxiv-2509-07366.creator: Sining Zhang, Zhengxuan Wang, Minping Zhang, Xilin Zhang and Guangtao Wang
arxiv-2509-07366.description: Abstract Our high-throughput computational screening of the Materials Project database has identified 140 candidate materials exhibiting antiferromagnetic behavior in the P ​ n ​ m ​ a Pnma space group. Through systematic density functional theory calculations comparing various magnetic configurations, we demonstrate that 91 of these compounds preferentially stabilize in altermagnetic ground states, with 20 adopting the perovskite structure.

pmc-10672438.title: Endovascular Embolization for Epistaxis: A Single Center Experience and Meta-Analysis
pmc-10672438.creator: Kareem El Naamani, Charles Morse, Marc Ghanem, Julie Barbera, Abdelaziz Amllay, Grace Severance, Ramon Ruiz, Ahmad Sweid, Michael R Gooch, Nabeel A Herial, Pascal Jabbour, Robert H Rosenwasser, Gurston G Nyquist, Stavropoula Tjoumakaris, Makoto Nakamura, Stavros Spiliopoulos
pmc-10672438.description: The optimal treatment for intractable epistaxis is still controversial. Various studies have demonstrated high success rates and low complication rates for endovascular embolization. Herein, the authors report an institutional experience and meta-analysis in terms of efficacy and safety of endovascular embolization of intractable epistaxis.

pmc-10868134.title: Does pain hurt more in Spanish? The neurobiology of pain among Spanish–English bilingual adults
pmc-10868134.creator: Morgan Gianola, Maria M Llabre, Elizabeth A Reynolds Losin
pmc-10868134.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). We previously found Spanish-English bilingual adults reported higher pain intensity when exposed to painful heat in the language of their stronger cultural orientation. Here, we elucidate brain systems involved in language-driven alterations in pain responses. During separate English- and Spanish-speaking fMRI scanning runs, 39 (21 female) bilingual adults rated painful heat intermixed between culturally evocative images and completed sentence reading tasks. Surveys of cultural identity and language use measured relative preference for US-American vs Hispanic culture (cultural orientation).

pmc-11355905.title: PAI1 Regulates Cell Morphology and Migration Markers in Trastuzumab-Resistant HER2-Positive Breast Cancer Cells
pmc-11355905.creator: Asiye Busra Boz Er, Idris Er
pmc-11355905.description: HER2-positive breast cancer is a significant cause of mortality. Overcoming trastuzumab resistance requires a deeper understanding of its molecular mechanisms to develop effective therapies. This study investigates the role of plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 (PAI1) in migration and drug resistance in trastuzumab-resistant HER2-positive breast cancer.

pmc-11416112.title: Validation of the Athens Insomnia Scale Among Young Chinese Male Population in a High-Altitude Situation
pmc-11416112.creator: Xugang Tang, Qiang Wang, Shuang Li, Xiuchuan Li, Qian Xin, Yongjian Yang
pmc-11416112.description: PurposeThe Athens Insomnia Scale (AIS) is a widely used and authorized questionnaire for evaluating insomnia symptoms. However, its reliability and validity at high altitudes are uncertain. Therefore, this study aimed to confirm the validity and reliability of AIS during a 3658 m altitude exposure.Patients and MethodsA total of 387 young Chinese males were enlisted in the acute high-altitude exposure group.

pmc-11417160.title: Association of plasma endothelin-1 levels with revascularization strategies and short-term clinical outcomes: Role of diabetes
pmc-11417160.creator: Fadia Mayyas, Khalid Ibrahim, Rasheed Ibdah, Abdullah Al-Kasasbeh, Muhannad J. Ababneh, Ala’Eldin A. Ababneh, Mohammad I. Jarrah, Sukaina Rawashdeh
pmc-11417160.description: Mortality rate due to coronary artery disease (CAD) is elevated among diabetes mellitus (DM) compared to non-DM patients. Endothelin 1 (ET-1), a potent vasoconstrictor, is implicated in the pathophysiology of both CAD and DM. The impact of ET-1 on the short-term clinical outcomes following revascularization by percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and coronary artery bypass surgery (CABG) remains unclear.

pmc-11424948.title: Joint segmentation and image reconstruction with error prediction in photoacoustic imaging using deep learning
pmc-11424948.creator: Ruibo Shang, Geoffrey P. Luke, Matthew O’Donnell
pmc-11424948.description: Deep learning has been used to improve photoacoustic (PA) image reconstruction. One major challenge is that errors cannot be quantified to validate predictions when ground truth is unknown. Validation is key to quantitative applications, especially using limited-bandwidth ultrasonic linear detector arrays.

pmc-13387302.title: Intrinsically Disordered Polypeptides‐Based Stealth Materials Enable Enhanced Photothermal Cancer Therapy Using an In Situ Fiber‐Based Penetrating Laser System
pmc-13387302.creator: Kei Nishida, Hiromasa Yamashita, Akira Takahashi, Eijiro Miyako
pmc-13387302.description: Photothermal therapy has emerged as a minimally invasive cancer treatment strategy, yet poor nanoparticle (NP) stability, nonspecific accumulation, and inefficient laser delivery to deep tumor tissues markedly limit conventional approaches. Here, we report the rational design of intrinsically disordered polypeptides (IDPs) as next‐generation stealth materials for photothermal cancer therapy applications using a novel contact‐mode laser irradiation system.

pmc-13458039.creator: Nishtha Sardana, Nitika Bajaj, Meenu Bhola
pmc-13458039.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AimMinimizing discomfort during administration of local anesthetics is crucial in pediatric dentistry to enhance cooperation and help create a pleasant experience for young patients. Both pharmacological and non-pharmacological strategies are used to reduce injection-related pain.

pmc-13580150.title: Somatic Hypermutations Enhance Neutralization Breadth of IGHV3‐53/3‐66 Public Antibodies Against SARS‐CoV‐2 Variants
pmc-13580150.creator: Takeo Kuwata, Kyo Okazaki, Hiroshi Morioka, Yu Kaku, Mikiko Shimizu, Yoshimi Maruyama, Ahmed K Hamdy, The Genotype to Phenotype Japan (G2P‐Japan) Consortium, Tateki Suzuki, Takao Hashiguchi, Kei Sato, Shuzo Matsushita
pmc-13580150.description: ObjectiveSevere acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS‐CoV‐2) continuously evolves to evade antibodies elicited by prior infection or vaccination. Most IGHV3‐53/3‐66 public antibodies potently neutralize the prototype strain, but show limited activity against recent variants. However, some acquire broad neutralizing activity through accumulation of somatic hypermutations. We assessed whether non‐broadly neutralizing IGHV3‐53/3‐66 antibodies could mature into broadly neutralizing antibodies.
